Summary of what shipped on `7d9cafb1` (branch `streamdoc/t_aba02e81-por-69-t4-additive-manifest-based-sample`, not pushed):

**Change** — `src/streamdoc/integrations/notebooklm/prompts.py`, `_seed_from_samples` only:
- Writes/reads a `.seeded_samples` manifest inside `templates_dir` (utf-8)
- seen-set = manifest lines ∪ existing `.yaml` basenames (existing files are the safety net)
- No manifest + ≥1 `.yaml` (pre-manifest install) → writes all shipped sample basenames as seen, copies nothing → deleted templates never resurrect
- Otherwise copies each sample not in the seen-set, writes the full set back — so newly shipped samples now reach existing installs
- Any manifest IO error → falls back to the original empty-dir-only behavior; init can never crash on seeding

**Tests** — `tests/test_sample_seeding_manifest.py` (new): 4 tmp_path tests covering fresh install, upgrade-no-manifest, late-added sample, and deleted-template — all watched failing before implementation, now passing.

**Evidence:**
- `uv run pytest tests/test_sample_seeding_manifest.py -q` → `4 passed in 1.06s`
- `uv run pytest tests/ -q -x -m "not live"` → 474 passed; the 5 failures (`test_agy_smoke` ×3, `test_notebooklm_auto_refresh` ×2) are pre-existing environment issues — verified identical on baseline with `prompts.py` stashed (agy CLI is installed on this machine; settings caches env before monkeypatch)
- `git diff --stat HEAD~1` → exactly `prompts.py` + `tests/test_sample_seeding_manifest.py`

`.devin-report.md` written at the worktree root with full evidence; left out of the commit to keep the diff clean.
